maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost four keypoints are arranged in a sparse linear sequence along the superior margin of the mystacial pad, positioned approximately 1.5 follicle-diameters above the secondary dense row with a slightly descending anterior-to-posterior orientation.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 98-100% melanin saturation; the visible apex of the rhinarium is composed of uniform dark pixels with no significant pink or depigmented areas visible.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: In this strictly lateral view, the contour from the superior orbital ridge to the nasal tip exhibits a continuous, slightly concave slope at an angle of approximately 35 degrees relative to the horizontal auditory-orbital axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular notch/indentation on the superior-posterior margin of the ear pinna.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast dark pixel cluster at the posterior commissure of the lips and a faint dark horizontal stripe extending from the lateral canthus of the eye.
